headline: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority has finalised a licensing framework for satellite-based in-flight telecommunication services, allowing internet and communication services aboard Pakistani-registered aircraft, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Pakistani jahazon mein satellite internet ki ijazat

caption:
Ab jahaz mein bhi internet chalega! ✈️
Business Recorder ke mutabiq PTA ne jahaz mein satellite internet aur communication services ke liye licensing framework final kar diya hai. Licensed companies Pakistan mein registered jahazon mein satellite ke zariye internet de sakengi. In companies ko Pakistan Space Activities Regulatory Board (PSARB) mein registration karwani hogi aur PTA ki licensing sharait poori karni hongi. Pakistan ki fazai hudood se guzarne wale jahazon ko PTA se NOC lena hoga. Is se musafir safar ke dauran internet, entertainment aur apna kaam bhi kar sakenge.
Kya aap safar mein jahaz par internet istemal karenge? Comment mein batayein 👇
